title: Juicy Crisp Greek Cheese Saganaki
description: A lazy Sunday Greek dish featuring garlicky, crisp cheese, this saganaki is perfect for a relaxing meal, it is kosher friendly and uses dashi extract for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Kefalotyri cheese into a 1-inch thick slice.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic and dashi extract.
Brush the garlic and dashi mixture evenly onto the cheese slice.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the cheese slice to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 5 minutes, until the cheese is melted and crispy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper over the cheese.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
